gates.title: Source and adoption integrity
gates.acceptance: Every adoption names actual packaged evidence and its limit; no private service or proprietary media is copied.

gates.title: Authorized full-document context
gates.acceptance: The context broker distinguishes current buffer, saved source, visible screenshot, partial read and verified full coverage.

gates.title: Screen guidance without hidden action
gates.acceptance: Annotations carry fresh target identity and do not execute input or impersonate a permission prompt.

gates.title: Safe verbatim dictation and insertion
gates.acceptance: Verbatim content and an optional rewrite stay distinct; exact focus/field and clipboard ownership are validated.

gates.title: Resumable personalized onboarding
gates.acceptance: Existing Métis desktop scene order and native-model ownership remain; progressive capability coaching, Tony-only welcome or text fallback, consent, no-run agent creation and replay are verified in the real product. No replacement wizard.

gates.title: Stable named-agent definitions
gates.acceptance: Agent identity is separate from models/skills/runs and changing its appearance cannot broaden authority.

gates.title: Correct routing and pinned providers
gates.acceptance: Explicit names, focus and turn context resolve to the correct authorized agent; provider pins never silently change.

gates.title: Isolated memory, drafts and source authority
gates.acceptance: Agent memory, draft and source scope are isolated by principal and stable namespace; shared knowledge remains canonical.

gates.title: Bounded concurrent runs and input leases
gates.acceptance: Only one current run can own desktop input per device; cancellation/generation and independent verification gate every effect.

gates.title: Explicit routines and calm suggestions
gates.acceptance: Recurring work has explicit scope, location, timezone and budget; attention respects meeting/privacy state.

gates.title: Probed connectors and typed schemas
gates.acceptance: Ready reflects a real scoped authenticated probe; typed write schemas and readback are required.

gates.title: Central skills and truthful capabilities
gates.acceptance: Published allowed skills determine capabilities; arbitrary local scripts and non-shipped tools do not become enabled by a label.

gates.title: Scoped artifacts and safe previews
gates.acceptance: Outputs exist and verify before presentation; preview, open, export, overwrite and share are separate authority decisions.

gates.title: Per-agent operational truth
gates.acceptance: Operator reconciles real operation, agent, skill, provider and billing identities without content logging.

gates.title: Minimal animated identity and fast Home
gates.acceptance: Orb-only ARMED remains; expanded names are clear, visible animations bounded, history paged and accessibility preserved.

gates.title: Real cross-platform end-to-end qualification
gates.acceptance: A native signed Windows/live-service journey and independent native Mac journey prove actual capabilities and remaining holds.

cases.scenario: A reference contains an old unused skill picker.
cases.expected: Classify the old note separately from live runtime proof; leave actual activation unverified.

cases.scenario: A source contains an account token or a private endpoint.
cases.expected: Do not call it or copy it into Métis; sanitize provenance and use Métis-owned authentication.

cases.scenario: Ask about an off-screen clause in a selected document.
cases.expected: Read the verified full revision through the permitted source or disclose visible-only coverage; cite the exact clause.

cases.scenario: Source permission is removed while extraction runs.
cases.expected: Invalidate the pending generation, do not attach late content and do not satisfy a pending approval with old context.

cases.scenario: Ask Métis to show which button changes export format.
cases.expected: Display a scoped fresh highlight with an explanation; no click or setting change.

cases.scenario: The target moves, scrolls or changes displays.
cases.expected: Invalidate the old highlight and reobserve; never point at the stale coordinate.

cases.scenario: Dictate Québec / R&D, do not send.
cases.expected: Preserve accents and negation; insert only into the approved field without pressing Send.

cases.scenario: Switch to a terminal or another app before insertion.
cases.expected: Block insertion; preserve the draft and offer explicit destination/copy choice.

cases.scenario: Create the recommended starter team then replay setup.
cases.expected: Retain the same IDs and existing work; do not create duplicates or launch tasks.

cases.scenario: Video, speech or an optional connector is unavailable.
cases.expected: Show truthful per-capability readiness, typed/static alternatives and working retry/exit paths.

cases.scenario: Rename Research Scout and change its orb.
cases.expected: Preserve ID, provider pin, memory, jobs and permissions; no duplicate agent.

cases.scenario: Ask to create three agents and then cancel before confirmation.
cases.expected: No task or routine starts; no unconfirmed definitions become active.

cases.scenario: Send a follow-up to a busy named Dust agent.
cases.expected: Queue under its real remote identity and thread; no generic model impersonation.

cases.scenario: Say do it after switching to a different agent or suggestion.
cases.expected: Require an exact pending target; never transfer the previous approval.

cases.scenario: Switch agents with unsent text and attachments.
cases.expected: Restore each exact draft/attachment/scroll state without leaking it into another request.

cases.scenario: Delete or correct an agent fact and regenerate knowledge.
cases.expected: Corrections propagate; deleted/revoked material cannot return from cached agent memory or old backup.

cases.scenario: Two agents request keyboard or pointer control simultaneously.
cases.expected: One lease owner acts, the other waits; no mixed typing or cursor race.

cases.scenario: Cancel a run as its provider result arrives.
cases.expected: Reject late dispatch, release authority, and reconcile any already attempted effect truthfully.

cases.scenario: A device-bound routine misses several runs while locked.
cases.expected: Skip/coalesce per explicit policy and require that device to be eligible; no storm or device substitution.

cases.scenario: A suggestion finishes during a meeting or screen share.
cases.expected: Keep it discoverable without unrequested speech, sound or sensitive floating text.

cases.scenario: Save a syntactically valid but rejected connector token.
cases.expected: Show checking then rejected; never report Connected merely because it was saved.

cases.scenario: An API result is large or paginated.
cases.expected: Use scoped pagination/fields; do not escape to broader GUI control as an automatic fallback.

cases.scenario: Publish a skill update while an agent is running.
cases.expected: Current run stays pinned, later runs use the qualified revision, revoked versions cannot execute.

cases.scenario: A role requests a capability whose provider is not present.
cases.expected: Report unsupported/unavailable accurately; do not loop on Retry or invent output.

cases.scenario: An agent generates a report and the user returns tomorrow.
cases.expected: Find the exact durable result from its manifest without regenerating or changing ownership.

cases.scenario: A preview contains scripts, remote images or a traversal filename.
cases.expected: Sandbox/reject unsafe content and paths; do not execute or exfiltrate.

cases.scenario: Two agents use the same server-held Jev key.
cases.expected: Attribute both attempts correctly and keep user/context isolation; do not double count delivery retries.

cases.scenario: A preview or starter-agent creation is mistaken for a live task.
cases.expected: Distinct event categories prevent fake usage/readiness; actual setup provider spend remains accounted.

cases.scenario: A catalog contains twenty agents and a thousand-turn chat.
cases.expected: Do not create twenty frame loops or render whole history per keystroke; measure actual resource use.

cases.scenario: Reduced motion, high contrast, 200% text or IME is active.
cases.expected: Keep names, source/approval controls and safe keyboard operation; no hidden required status.

cases.scenario: A new user completes agent creation, context, approval and result.
cases.expected: Verify real source, backend, action, knowledge/Dust and Operator receipt on the exact candidate.

cases.scenario: The native or provider prerequisite is not available.
cases.expected: Keep that slice BLOCKED and do independent work; do not pass it from HTML or another platform.
